name: Star-delta transformer
summary: A star-delta transformer connects one winding set in star and the other in delta.
description: A star-delta transformer connects one winding set in star and the other in delta. The notation identifies winding topology; a clock-number or equivalent phase-displacement designation is still needed where system phase relationships matter.
readingNotes: Read which side is star from the declared primary and secondary labels.
